answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. A sable of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ember of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the sonnet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
